text: #342 changes four ratified acceptance tests' exhaustive refusals, since exhaustive Python applications are admitted now: TestPythonApplicationPreservesLegacyAndRefusesExecution (#310), TestPythonApplicationExecutionBoundaries (#315), and TestPythonApplicationGateAdmission and TestPythonApplicationGateCLI (#327). Each still refuses an unsupported configuration before any tool runs, now a proof selection, or without components existing code that has no callable to bind or isn't there, the admission tests admit exhaustive manifests beside sampled ones, and an unknown sampling key is named as that. Nothing else in them changes. It changes ratified tests, so it waits for @gitdek's ratification.
